resources.string: Choose a TTF or OTF file up to 64 MiB. Toki keeps a private copy and selects it for custom subtitle styling; your source file stays unchanged. Collection/web fonts (TTC, WOFF) are not supported. This does not enable custom rendering or translation.
Selected: %1$s. Return to subtitle settings to preview it in custom rendering mode.
Font import did not complete. Choose a valid TTF or OTF file within the size limit and check available storage.
Imported fonts apply in Toki custom rendering mode. Selecting a system family switches back without deleting imported files.
Open or update the Toki manager to import and read custom fonts.
The preview and playback update together. Bilingual lines are composed by Toki; native appearance keeps native typography where available. Missing translations show the original only.
